phases.goal: Finish all five chapters and pick up the story trophies, the side-character strands and the groundwork for 100%.
phases.name: Play the story
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing (Just Like Paradise).
Chapter 1: after Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in the morning — the only possibly missable step in the whole list.

Finish Chapters 1-4 (Paradise Lost, T**s Ass Drug Money, Vice City, Baby!, Top Of The World, Ma) and the story missions: Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory.
In Chapter 4, take the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — it unlocks the bank vault robberies.
Take optional missions as they appear, especially ones introducing robberies, fishing and hunting.
Scan unfamiliar vehicles with WAiNK and study animals through the binoculars as you travel — the progress counts toward 100% later.
Start the stranger chains as soon as they unlock: Andy (Lucia-only), Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone (Jason-only), Bret (Jason-only).
Finish the final mission (You Gotta Know When to Get Off, gold) and reach free-roam.

phases.goal: Work the 100% Completion checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) and earn A Long Road.
phases.name: 100% completion
steps: Open the checklist and work it in the open world; progress from the story already counts.
Complete all robberies: gang operations, bank jobs, payday loan jobs and 8 bank vaults (Maximum Withdrawal pops at 5).
Finish the collectibles: 15 card sets (Don't Touch My Deck pops at 3), 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos.
Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges (The Shootist) and win a drone race at all 14 locations (Top Fun).
Complete 250 stunts (Cunning Stunts) and keep going to 300 for the checklist; win 20 races (Earn Cash, Not Kudos) and keep going to 30.
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges — skip the ten hardest (One Last Thing pops at 50).
Scan 200 of 277 vehicles (Whip It Good pops at 100), study 100 of 255 animals, find 50 of 66 weapons.
Meditate at the remaining spots (Positive Mental Attitude) and clear the fog across Leonida (The Goodtime State).
The checklist hits 100% and A Long Road (gold) pops.

phases.goal: Finish whatever is left and watch the platinum pop.
phases.name: Cleanup and the platinum
steps: Complete any remaining Strangers & Freaks strands — eight in total for the silver.
Finish the side-character final missions you have not done yet.
Sweep the miscellaneous trophies: the wanted-level, robbery and stunt one-offs (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Gunslinger, Sneakthief, A Classic Blitz Play, Catch Me If You Can, Challenging Tank).
Try the unconfirmed ones last and check a current guide first: In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin.
Spend $100,000 across shops (Treat Yo Self), launder $250,000 in Marked Bills (Dime on the Dollar), buy the 8 garages (Little Boxes), register 10 vehicles in Scooter Bros (On the Spot).
Check the tracker in this guide: when all 54 others are ticked, Vice Got a Price! pops.

sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements
summary: One playthrough, about 200 hours, no online trophies. PowerPyx rates the set 4 out of 10: the story is 60-80 hours, the 100% checklist about 100 hours, and cleanup about 10 hours. Cheats disable trophies and saving, there is no mission replay, and free-roam continues after the story.
title: Roadmap to the Platinum
warnings: The only possibly missable trophy is Positive Mental Attitude: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends (see its guide).
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter — missions cannot be replayed.
Start stranger mission chains as soon as they unlock; TechWiser reports their windows are linked to story progress.
The Irredeemable Criminal Profile is permanent (PowerPyx, GTABase) — check before going on a rampage.
Andy's strand is Lucia-only; Tyrone's and Bret's are Jason-only.
